Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat graphic layout: one bordered card holding three numbered rows, each row pairing one thin single-weight line glyph with a small square inset; the three insets read straight-on, from 45 degrees above and from a clean 90-degree side profile so the panels differ while sharing one light. Soft even warm 5100K light with a controlled highlight on the fabric and no hard edges. Background: page stock #FFFFFF with a caramel #D3A277 header band across the card top and one apricot #FBDCB2 block behind the card corner. Props: none. Card and insets occupy 45-50% of the frame. Text zone: the card title 「{callout_15}」 at 26pt in #3A342F reversed on the caramel band, three numbered instruction labels 「{callout_16}」 at 14pt in #3A342F each followed by one blank placeholder copy rule, and one brick-red #C0453A checkbox emphasis line 「{callout_17}」 at 14pt along the card bottom. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, inspection reports, ratings, lab numbers or test data, no fake seals, no guarantee wording, no QR code, no membership or store-recruitment wording, no readable brand marks, no duplicated inset photographs, no watermark.

shots.intent: 大圆角驼色卡复述核心主张并给出行动按钮，用后侧 45 度读法补一次衣长与背部版型证据，收口整页动线。
shots.camera: photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle onto the garment inside one large rounded card panel, model cropped from the shoulders down so the back panel and hem band read clearly
shots.lighting: bright soft warm 4900K daylight with a gentle upper-left key, one faint rim lifting the shoulder line, soft contact shadow under the hem
shots.background: caramel #D3A277 rounded card sitting on an apricot #FBDCB2 field with one oversized letter-spaced Latin ghost word behind the subject, two solid brick-red #C0453A discs and one short slash rule
shots.whitespace: lower third of the card reserved for the headline and the button
shots.textZone: 卡面下方中文主张「{selling_point_6}」32pt #3A342F + 一枚砖红 #C0453A 圆角按钮「{callout_18}」16pt 反白
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing offer card of {product}. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle onto the garment presented inside one large rounded card panel, the model cropped from the shoulders down so the back panel and hem band read clearly. Bright soft warm 4900K daylight with a gentle upper-left key, one faint rim lifting the shoulder line and a soft contact shadow under the hem. Background: a caramel #D3A277 rounded card sitting on an apricot #FBDCB2 field with one oversized letter-spaced Latin ghost word behind the subject as a pure graphic layer carrying no brand wording, two solid brick-red #C0453A discs and one short slash rule. Props: none. Garment occupies 50-60% of the frame, lower third of the card kept clear. Text zone: the closing headline 「{selling_point_6}」 at 32pt in #3A342F plus one rounded action button reading 「{callout_18}」 at 16pt in #FFFFFF on a brick-red #C0453A button. Negative: no invented discounts, no countdown timer, no price figures, no QR code, no membership or store-recruitment wording, no readable brand marks, no text beyond the headline and the button, no identifiable face, no cut-off hem edges, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 源夹标注女装（8），实收 20 张详情页切片；判读主品为女式复古慵懒风撞色竖罗纹毛针织衫（领口另有一圈针织颈圈），L1 女装 / L2 上衣与源图一致。20 镜压缩为 11 镜漏斗（HERO 开场、CTA 收口），已合并重复的纯色块占位屏、三处同款 细节展示 说明条与两张 加号 内搭画框屏，删除无任何信息的空白色块屏。已剥离：模特面容与身份（一律改为齐下颌以上裁切或侧背对镜头）、针织颈圈上的字母字样、末屏黑色 加入会员／全店免费 二维码角标、首屏与中间屏的英文填充句（SO BEAUTIFUL FOR YOU、TENDER APRICOT、VISUAL FENG OFTEN GIVE PRIZE 等一律降级为不承载品牌词的拉丁装饰层）、面料百分比（53.8%腈纶等）、衣长胸围等尺码数值与尺码推荐表（源图五行重复同一组占位值，全部改为空白取值）。保留的可复用视觉语法：杏桃与焦糖低饱和硬边色块叠层、细线描边画框加偏位色块、砖红下划与浅雾蓝擦痕强调、线描双栏图标卡、砖红勾选与小加号圆点、灰底表头信息表、四档属性刻度、正背双栏平铺对照、编号三步护理卡、超大字距拉丁装饰字。注意：源图多个图位为空白色块，相应构图与机位依据其残留说明文字与画框边界推定，未凭空添加源图没有的功效或质检背书。
